Peninsular Petroleum Corporation 
 
 Government of India / State Authority · Maharashtra · IN
 
 
 Work Completion CertifiCate 
 
 Issued under the provisions of the General Conditions of Contract
 
 Ref: CC/11/2019/140 Date: March 31, 2026 
 
 1. partiCulars of the Work 
 
 
 the particulars of the work executed and the terms on which it was awarded is set out below,
 drawn from the measurement and billing records for the contract. 
 
 Name of Work Pipeline Laying - Maharashtra Pkg-140 
 
 Nature / Category Water Supply 
 
 Contract / Tender Reference N/A 
 
 Contract Value (Original) INR 2.82 Cr 
 
 Completion Date 2019-08-28 
 
 Defect Liability Period N/A days from completion 
 
 Agency (Contractor) National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. 
 
 GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1 
 
 PAN NAICC4417O 
 
 Contractor's Project Manager Rahul Menon 
 
 2. sCope of Work exeCuted 
 
 
 Water Supply works for Peninsular Petroleum Corporation completed 2019. 
 The work was carried out under site conditions that included restricted access requiring night-
 
 time material movement. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to
 the department for additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep
 
 the critical path intact. 
 An extension of time was granted during execution on account of a revision to the approved
 
 drawings issued after mobilisation. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond
 the agency's control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-140 Page 1 of 3

The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the
 approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has
 been completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief /
 
 Superintending Engineer. 
 
 3. Quality assessment 
 
 The overall quality of the completed work is graded Excellent. Workmanship was good, with
 
 finishing standards above the specified norm, and the work was inspected in stages, with each
 stage recorded in the measurement book. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the
 
 test results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.
 
 Parameter Assessment Remarks 
 
 Workmanship Satisfactory As per IS codes and approved specifications
 
 Material Quality Satisfactory Test certificates on record 
 
 Dimensional Compliance Satisfactory Verified against approved drawings 
 
 Safety Compliance Satisfactory BOCW Act provisions followed 
 
 4. milestone status 
 
 the milestone position as recorded at the time of handover is set out below, as certified by the
 
 officers named at the foot of this document. 
 
 Milestone Planned Date Actual Date Status 
 
 Site Mobilisation 2019-08-28 2019-08-28 ✅ Completed 
 
 Execution Phase 2019-08-28 2019-08-28 ✅ Completed 
 
 Final Inspection 2019-08-28 2019-08-28 ✅ Completed 
 
 
 5. defiCienCy / observation list 
 
 At the time of taking over, no deficiency of consequence was recorded at handover. Regarding
 site safety, the site maintained its safety induction register without lapse. The agency's conduct
 
 during the contract is recorded as responsive throughout the defect liability period.
 
 Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2019-08-28. All
 minor observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the
 satisfaction of the inspecting authority. 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-140 Page 2 of 3

6. reCommendation 
 
 Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of
 the joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and
 
 recommend release of the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of
 the defect liability period. Certified by V. Iyer, Executive Engineer. 
 
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
 satisfactory completion of the final inspection. 
 
 This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the
 contractor of any obligations under the contract, including the defect liability period.
 
 CONFIDENTIAL - FOR AUTHORISED USE ONLY 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 V. Iyer, Executive Engineer 
 Peninsular Petroleum Corporation 
 Maharashtra, India 
 Date: March 31, 2026 Rahul Menon 
 Project Manager 
 
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-140 Page 3 of 3
